subject: Maths
title: One-step equations
subtitle: Solving Linear Equations · GCSE Maths
learning_objective: I can solve one-step linear equations using inverse operations.

key_vocab.definition: A one-step equation needs only ONE inverse operation to solve, e.g. x + 5 = 12 needs only −5.

sections.title: Learning Objective
sections.content: I can solve one-step linear equations using inverse operations.

sections.title: Key Words
sections.content: one-step equation -- A one-step equation needs only ONE inverse operation to solve, e.g. x + 5 = 12 needs only −5.

sections.title: Method
sections.content:
Use the INVERSE operation to undo what's done to x. Apply it to BOTH sides.
x + 5 = 12 ⇒ x = 7
Subtract 5 from both sides

Key examples:
  ✓ + ↔ −  (inverses)
  ✓ × ↔ ÷  (inverses)
  ✓ x + 5 = 12 → x = 7  (subtract 5)
  ✗ 3x = 12 → x = 9 (wrong: should ÷)  (÷ not −)
  ✗ Only do operation on one side  (must do BOTH sides)

sections.title: Worked Example
sections.content:
Example 1 – addition
  Solve x + 7 = 15
  Inverse of +7 is −7
  x + 7 − 7 = 15 − 7
  x = 8
  x = 8
  (Check: 8 + 7 = 15 ✓)

Example 2 – subtraction
  Solve x − 9 = 4
  Inverse of −9 is +9
  x − 9 + 9 = 4 + 9
  x = 13
  x = 13
  (Check: 13 − 9 = 4 ✓)

sections.title: Add/subtract
sections.content:
Use the inverse operation.

(a) x + 5 = 12
(b) x + 11 = 20
(c) x − 6 = 10
(d) x − 4 = 9

sections.title: Multiply/divide
sections.content:
Use the inverse operation.

(a) 3x = 18
(b) 7x = 56
(c) x ÷ 5 = 6
(d) x ÷ 8 = 4

sections.title: With negatives
sections.content:
Be careful with sign changes.

(a) x + 12 = 5
(b) x − 3 = −10
(c) −4x = 24
(d) x ÷ −3 = 5

sections.title: Word problems
sections.content:
Form an equation, then solve.

(a) I think of x. Add 9 to get 22. Find x.
(b) Multiply x by 4 to get 28. Find x.
(c) Divide x by 3 to get 12. Find x.
(d) Subtract 8 from x to get 0. Find x.

sections.title: Mixed one-step
sections.content:
Identify the operation, then apply its inverse.

(a) x + 17 = 25
(b) 11x = 121
(c) x − 4.5 = 2.5
(d) x ÷ 6 = 9
(e) x + 2.4 = 5.1

sections.title: Common Mistakes
sections.content:
✗ x + 5 = 12 means x = 17
✓ 5x = 25 means x = 5
✓ Whatever you do to one side, do to the other
✗ Inverse of ×3 is ×3
✓ x ÷ 4 = 8 means x = 32
